features.featureTitle: Fix the product card “Order on WhatsApp” call-to-action so the WhatsApp link reliably opens when clicked. Ensure the clickable element is a real anchor (<a>) with the WhatsApp URL in its href (not a nested/overlaid element that can block navigation), and keep the existing WhatsApp deep links exactly as they are in the app (Bike Tyres: https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX, Car Tyres: https://wa.me/919242253234).
